title: Tech Note: 4D v12 and Exchange Web Services
author: Jesse Pina, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: php-ews PHP library called from 4D's embedded PHP interpreter
4D methods for retrieving folders, contacts, tasks, and calendar events from Exchange

historical_commentary.text: This EWS-via-PHP integration pattern is dated: Microsoft has since deprecated EWS in favor of the Microsoft Graph API for Exchange Online/Office 365 integration, and the php-ews library is no longer actively maintained. A modern 4D integration with Exchange/Outlook data would use Microsoft Graph's REST/OAuth2 API directly from 4D's native HTTP/REST commands rather than routing through a PHP library and the legacy EWS protocol.
related_updates: Microsoft Graph API has superseded Exchange Web Services (EWS) as Microsoft's recommended integration point for Exchange Online/Office 365
4D's native HTTP/REST commands can call Graph's REST API directly without a PHP intermediary
